title: First substantive phased-array article
why: Turn the saved beam-squint writing brief into an owner-written, reproducible phased-array study and publish it after scientific and editorial review.
done_when: The owner-written article, reproducible code and scientific figures are reviewed, its model assumptions and limitations are explicit, the owner approves publication, and the published article passes site/discovery checks.
success_metrics: A focused question about directional-response loss versus bandwidth, aperture and scan angle.
Reproducible figures and independent checks support the conclusions; no invented measurements or novelty claims.
One owner-approved substantive article is published with correct labels, date, references and discovery outputs.
kill_conditions: Re-scope if the first article expands into an unmanageable multi-effect hardware study.
Do not publish unsupported numerical/physical claims or a manuscript the owner has not approved.

phases.title: Owner-requested visual corrections before writing
phases.useful_alone: Articles regain the owner-preferred palette, aligned reading layout and immediately available demos.
phases.done_when: Palette, contents, prose width and plot sizing are corrected; automatic demos and fallback behavior pass browser checks.

items.text: Restore neutral zinc dark colors, simplify collapsed Contents, align article prose with applets, and reduce scaled chart height/labels.

evidence.value: src/styles/global.css; src/components/article/TableOfContents.astro; shared chart geometry and article layout. Desktop/mobile screenshots inspected in dark and light themes.

items.text: Automatically mount all four demos on article entry without a load gate or focus jump, preserving static no-JavaScript/error alternatives; document the owner correction.

evidence.value: Production build, output checks, numerical identities and payload budget pass. Browser matrix: four demos × 1440/390px × dark/light; automatic controls, aligned prose, no page overflow/focus theft, keyboard disclosure/control endpoints and axe WCAG A/AA pass. No-JavaScript and blocked-module fallback checked. Application JS 210521 decoded / 69785 gzip bytes; controller 1479 gzip bytes.

docs/interactive-demos.md records the 2026-10-21 browser matrix and failure checks: blocked controller/module, simulated render failure, timeout/late completion and theme persistence. Local Chromium only; no owner visual approval or universal-device claim.

items.text: Center displayed equations across articles; correct same-line double-dollar delimiters, preserve inline math and readable local overflow, and document the authoring convention.

evidence.value: Build and output checks pass. All eight existing equations render as KaTeX display blocks across four articles. Local Chromium verifies geometric centering at 1440/390px in dark/light themes, inline math preservation, no page overflow, no-JavaScript rendering and keyboard scrolling of a simulated wide equation. Desktop screenshot inspected.

items.text: Center article tables as blocks while retaining author-controlled cell alignment and local horizontal scrolling.

evidence.value: Build/output checks pass. Local Chromium verifies both table-bearing articles at 1440/390px in dark/light and no-JavaScript mode: centered bounds, semantic headers, no page overflow. Simulated wide tables remain keyboard-scrollable. Desktop table screenshot inspected.

items.text: Remove appended permalink symbols beside section headings while retaining native section IDs and Contents navigation.

evidence.value: Build and output checks pass. Local Chromium at 1440/390px in dark/light and JavaScript/no-JavaScript modes verifies plain heading text, absent appended symbols and keyboard Contents navigation to the preserved focusable heading ID.

items.text: Replace the persistent demo explanation box with a transient tooltip on the article Demo badge, preserving discovery metadata and accessible interaction.

evidence.value: Build/output checks pass, including retained Demo metadata and no persistent notice. Local Chromium verifies all five articles at 1440/390/320px in both themes: initially hidden explanation, hover/focus reveal, hoverable tooltip, Escape dismissal and on-screen bounds. Touch reveal/outside-tap dismissal also pass with and without JavaScript; no-JavaScript Escape dismissal is not implemented.

items.text: Provide a temporary HTTPS-accessible visual comparison of the original and current phased-array demos and complete article pages.

Production build/output checks pass for 16 pages. Local Chromium checks desktop/mobile, both themes, JS/no-JS, keyboard view switching, image decoding, no page overflow and noindex metadata. Route excluded from sitemap, search and RSS; normal article remains unchanged.

items.text: Restore the original compact Plotly presentation across all four public demos, add working axis titles, retain numerical corrections and static fallbacks, and remove the completed comparison preview.

evidence.value: Owner: “I prefer the old version. A lot. A fucking lot. Only thing it misses: the Theta and module of AF on axis. Only things. For all demos… return to the old plot shit.. only add the names on axis if missing”. This supersedes live-SVG presentation decisions; original numerical errors are not reintroduced.

Production build, 15-page output checks, numerical identities and explicit restored-Plotly budget pass. Total JS 5016587 decoded / 1531105 gzip bytes; controller 1559 gzip bytes. Local Chromium covers four demos × 1440/390px × dark/light: all axis titles, original 384px/192px/256px heights, Fourier bars, compact live content, slider endpoints, no page overflow/focus jump or browser errors. Separate no-JS/import/render/timeout fallback checks pass; default screenshots inspected, axis title bounds, live theme update and mobile resize pass.

items.text: Improve phone array plot geometry: remove the redundant title, place |AF| horizontally above the y-axis, narrow padding/margins, and prevent accidental touch zoom.

evidence.value: Production build, output/model/payload checks pass. Local Chromium at 320/390/430/1440px in both themes verifies horizontal labels within bounds, no chart/rotated y title, >78% of chart width used by plotting area, 288px phone/384px desktop heights, keyboard dB toggle, correct fixed linear/dB ranges, no page overflow, and no-JavaScript/import-failure fallback. items.text: Apply the compact phone layout to every live demo plot: horizontal y labels, hidden y-zero text, no redundant titles, tighter margins/padding and locked gestures.

evidence.value: Build, 15-page output checks, numerical identities and payload budget pass (5017144 decoded / 1531379 gzip JS bytes). items.text: Remove archive intro/count, move topics and magnifying-glass search into a collapsible right panel, lowercase public branding, and restore the earlier compact About structure.

evidence.value: Production build and output/model/payload checks pass (15 pages; existing article/discovery boundaries preserved). Local Chromium verifies 320/390/1440px in dark/light: panel bounds, keyboard toggle/Escape/outside close, topic link/current states, search GET query/results, axe WCAG A/AA and no page overflow. phases.title: Design refinement before article publication
phases.useful_alone: A slim animated navigation and an inspectable editorial grid improve the existing site before new articles are published.
phases.done_when: The owner has reviewed the visual direction and agreed the grid/article presentation, with appropriate browser checks passing.

items.text: Slim the header, replace boxed controls with icons, implement animated right drawer, remove repeated article CTAs and deliver an interim editorial grid with design references.

evidence.value: Production build/output/model/payload checks pass. Local Chromium at 320/390/1440px in both themes verifies 53px total header, icon-only controls, CTA removal, divider-based two-column grid, drawer bounds/focus/Escape/backdrop/search and axe WCAG A/AA. In-flight transform proves slide animation; reduced motion, no-JavaScript disclosure, unsupported-dialog fallback and short-landscape navigation pass. Screenshots inspected. No animation dependency added; physical Safari not tested.

docs/design-direction.md records the current pass and primary reference links: Medium engineering feed, Distill, Bartosz Ciechanowski and Stripe Blog. The grid is explicitly interim, not owner-approved final design.

Final interaction review additionally verifies Escape from a populated search input, pointer-driven open/close without changing page scroll, and icon theme persistence after reload. Escape is captured before the browser search-input clear action.

items.text: Review reference sites and agree the remaining grid/article visual direction with the owner before publishing substantive articles.
Replace opening model-assumption callouts with closing Key takeaways and move article Contents into a collapsible left PDF-style outline.

evidence.value: Production build, 15-page route/discovery checks, numerical model checks and payload budget pass (5017406 decoded / 1531505 gzip JS bytes). Local Chromium verifies all five articles at 320/390/1024/1440px in dark/light: removed assumptions boxes, closing takeaways, left outline geometry, section jumps/focus, desktop reserved space, phone dismissal, no overflow and axe WCAG A/AA. Desktop/phone screenshots inspected. All four live demos resize without overflow when the outline opens; section highlighting, Escape from reading content, independent right dialog and reduced motion pass. Blocked-Plotly static fallback and outline selection pass. Physical Safari not tested.

docs/article-authoring.md, docs/templates/article.mdx and mirrored AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md document takeaways metadata and left-outline behavior. Scientific model context remains in prose. The final grid/article visual-review decision remains open.
No-JavaScript phone/desktop review verifies native disclosure, section fragment links, closing summary and no page overflow. Without scripts the phone outline is closed manually through its summary.

items.text: Remove the article-end All writing link and slim the shared footer; measure reference typography and record unresolved layout/settings options.

evidence.value: Production build and 15-page route/discovery/privacy checks pass. Local Chromium at 320/390/1440px in dark/light verifies absent All writing link, 61px footer, 12px labels, no horizontal overflow, keyboard About-to-RSS focus order and axe WCAG A/AA on the footer. Phone no-JavaScript About navigation passes; screenshot inspected. Physical Safari not tested.

Width/font, Explore layer, edge controls and settings/dashboard remain recommendations for owner review.

items.text: Trial an 880px shared article canvas with 18px/30px prose, centralized settings, paired animated header-edge panels and expandable applet widths.

evidence.value: Production build, 15-page route/discovery/privacy checks, independent numerical identities and payload budget pass (5018025 decoded / 1531712 gzip application JS bytes; demo controller 1767 gzip bytes). Local Chromium at 320/390/1024/1440/1920px in both themes verifies 880px maximum aligned canvas, 18px/30px prose, edge controls, modal phone versus nonmodal docked desktop behavior, reserved margins, mutual exclusion, Escape, focus containment, expansion/restore and axe WCAG A/AA. Screenshots inspected.

All four live demos expand to 1280px when space permits and fit reserved-panel/phone widths without overflow; reduced motion and cross-breakpoint dialog mode switching pass. Mirrored in-flight slide, phone section-target focus, populated-search Escape, in-flight expansion overflow and keyboard restoration pass. Native no-JavaScript phone navigation and blocked Plotly static fallback pass. Physical Safari not tested.

src/styles/settings.css is the central visual-default file. README, architecture, interactive-demo and authoring guides document the trial; mirrored AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md record the owner decisions. docs/layout-review.md retains reference font/line-height measurements. Final owner visual approval remains open.
Additional desktop no-JavaScript review confirms exclusive native disclosures and left/right reserved margins; mobile Explore GET search returns Pagefind results.

items.text: Trial 25px prose line spacing, stable Explore hover motion, 1.5× expanded plot heights and shared outside-click layout restoration.

evidence.value: Production build, 15-page output/discovery/privacy checks, independent numerical models and payload budget pass (5018096 decoded / 1531740 gzip application JS bytes; demo controller 1790 gzip bytes). Local Chromium checks four demos at 390/1440px in both themes: 25px line height, exact normal/1.5× expanded plot heights including both Fourier plots, bounded widths, functional keyboard sliders, inside-click preservation, gutter dismissal/restoration, left/right dialog dismissal, no page overflow and axe WCAG A/AA. Physical Safari not tested.

items.text: Use one proportional plot scale capped at 1.5×, fitted to browser viewport dimensions and available space with responsive panel/window updates.

evidence.value: Production build, 15-page output/discovery/privacy checks, independent demo models and payload budget pass (5019806 decoded / 1532439 gzip application JS bytes; controller 2479 gzip bytes). Pure fitting checks cover maximum, width/height limits, undersized space and zero dimensions. Local Chromium verifies all four demos at 390×844, 1024×768, 1280×800, 1440×900 and 1920×650 in both themes: matching expanded width/height ratios, factor between 1 and 1.5, short-window limits, no-room disabled controls, fit without overflow, panel-aware recalculation and slider preservation. Screenshots inspected; axe WCAG A/AA passes on representative expanded articles.

Live window resizing across wide, short and phone viewports preserves chosen slider values and recalculates scale; reduced motion/Escape and outside restoration pass. No-JavaScript and blocked-engine static alternatives remain readable with unavailable expansion hidden. Physical Safari not tested.

docs/responsive-plots.md explains the algorithm, reusable viewport helper, per-chart height budget and normal-size floor. Settings, README, architecture and mirrored instruction files record proportional fitting; final design approval remains open.

items.text: Replace discontinuous debounced plot resizing with coalesced relayout, try 27px prose line spacing and hide internal reference keys.

evidence.value: Production build, 15-page output/discovery/privacy checks, independent models and payload budget pass (5020051 decoded / 1532575 gzip application JS bytes; controller 2483 gzip bytes). Local Chromium samples four demos/five plots in both themes through expansion/collapse: 8–19 distinct geometry redraws during each 420ms transition and final chart/container agreement within 1px. The coalesced relayout path replaces delayed Plots.resize; separate ease-in-out plot timing reduces abrupt initial movement. This is measured local Chromium behavior, not a 60fps or universal-device guarantee.

27px prose line height, hidden reference keys with retained ref-* IDs/descriptive links, keyboard sliders, panel resizing, phone resize, reduced motion and representative axe WCAG A/AA pass. Rapid reversal and theme change during resizing settle correctly without page errors. Viewport/short-window fit, slider persistence, no-JavaScript and blocked-engine static alternatives also pass. Reference screenshot inspected; physical Safari not tested.

README, architecture, authoring and responsive-plot guidance document 18px/27px prose, hidden bibliography keys and serialized resize updates. Mirrored AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md remain identical. Final owner design approval remains open.

Final feature/media shape approval remains open; latest-article/landscape are the stated initial trial.

phases.title: Owner manuscript and reproducible evidence
phases.useful_alone: A bounded research question and inspectable manuscript/code/figure package can be reviewed before publication.
phases.done_when: The owner provides a manuscript plus code/figures or explicitly scoped analytical evidence for the agreed study.

items.text: Carry forward the saved beam-squint brief and record the owner’s instruction to close website setup and focus on the first article.

evidence.value: The owner said “Ok” to the proposal, asked to keep it as a reminder, and requested closing the foundation roadmap before the first article. The existing idea contains the central question, suggested sweep, three figures, sources and model limits. No manuscript or results are claimed.

items.text: Owner writes the phased-array manuscript and provides reproducible code/figures; use the saved beam-squint brief as the working direction, with scope refined by the owner.

phases.title: Scientific review and publication
phases.useful_alone: The completed article can be read, checked and followed through the site.
phases.done_when: Claims/model/evidence pass review, the owner approves the final article, and production/draft/discovery/browser checks pass before publication.

items.text: Review angle/phase conventions, normalization, fixed physical spacing, visible solutions, numerical identities, scientific captions, references and model limits against the actual manuscript/evidence.
With owner approval, prepare final MDX and a genuine publication date; verify figures, math, mobile/desktop, keyboard, themes, draft exclusion and search/RSS/related/sitemap, then publish.

open_questions: When will the owner provide the first manuscript and its code/figures?
A notification time/timezone has not been supplied; no timed reminder has been scheduled.
Which reference direction should guide the next grid/article design pass? Final visual review remains open before publication.
